changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.8.3:

• 👁️ Real-Time Live Screen Vision Fix: Fixed Gemini Live WebSocket payload to use official media_chunks format. JARVIS now receives real-time mobile screen frames at 1 FPS and accurately sees your active screen.

• 📱 High-Definition 720p Screen Capture: Upgraded screen capture to crisp 720p with 70% JPEG quality and scaled VirtualDisplay DPI, eliminating blurry text and crushed Android layouts.

• 🗣️ Voice-Activated Screen Sharing: Added control_screen_share tool. You can now start or stop screen sharing simply by saying 'Jarvis screen share karo' or 'screen dekho'.

• 🎯 Strict Anti-Hallucination: Enhanced vision instructions to prevent JARVIS from assuming the user is on the home screen or looking at apps when an app or game is open.
